description: This Java source file defines the 'Book' entity class for a book-tracking application. It includes fields for book details, relationships to authors, shelves, tags, publishers, and methods for managing these relationships and properties.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: Entity class representing a book with properties like title, author, genre, format, edition, ISBN, publication year, relationships to shelves, tags, publishers, and reading status. Includes methods for managing relationships and properties, and static utility for edition string conversion.

methods.name: convertToBookEdition
methods.description: Converts an integer edition number to a string with ordinal suffix (e.g., '1st edition').

methods.name: setEdition
methods.description: Sets the edition string based on an integer input.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Adds a tag to the book and updates the tag's book list.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a tag from the book and updates the tag's book list.

methods.name: addPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Associates a predefined shelf with the book and updates the shelf’s book list.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelf
methods.description: Removes the association with the predefined shelf.

methods.name: removeAuthor
methods.description: Removes the author association from the book.

methods.name: setPublicationYear
methods.description: Sets the publication year of the book.

methods.name: addGenre
methods.description: Adds a genre to the book's genre set.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a publisher to the book and updates the publisher’s book list.

methods.name: removePublisher
methods.description: Removes a publisher from the book and updates the publisher’s book list.
